Article 3.3: Trading the News (Holiday Hours)

Warren's summary

During Evaluation phase, you may trade T1 news events as long as you don't blow the account, but in Exhibition or Funded accounts, holding any position through a T1 news event results in immediate account liquidation, forfeiture of all profits, ineligibility for funding, and no appeal. You must be completely flat (no open positions, no pending orders) for 1 minute before, during, and 1 minute after every T1 news event. FFN provides a Financial News Calendar via Financial Juice on your dashboard where you can filter for USA High-Impact Tier 1 events like CPI, FOMC Rate Decisions, NFP, and GDP releases, and the firm also posts holiday trading schedules on Discord and the website following the official CME Group schedule.

Where News Rules Apply
Account Phase	T1 News Trading Permitted?
Evaluation (all account types)	YES: does not blow the account
Exhibition (OG accounts)	NO: immediate account liquidation
Sim-Funded (all types)	NO: immediate account liquidation
FFN Institution	NO: immediate account liquidation
What Happens If You Trade T1 News in Exhibition or Funded?
CRITICAL RULE: T1 NEWS VIOLATION IN EXHIBITION OR FUNDED If you hold a position through a T1 news event in an Exhibition or Funded account, the account is immediately liquidated. You will NOT be eligible for funding, and ALL profits in the account are forfeited. This cannot be reversed. There is no appeal process.
The Rule: Be FLAT Around T1 Events

You must be completely FLAT (no open positions, no pending orders) for the following window around every T1 news event:

1 minute BEFORE the event
DURING the event
1 minute AFTER the event
How to Find T1 Events
FFN provides a built-in Financial News Calendar via Financial Juice, accessible from your dashboard.
Filter the calendar to show USA High-Impact Tier 1 (T1) events only.
Common T1 events include: CPI, FOMC Rate Decisions, NFP (Non-Farm Payrolls), GDP releases.
FFN also announces holiday trading sessions via Discord and the website.
Holiday Trading Sessions

On CME holidays or early-close days, FFN follows the official CME Group schedule. Holiday sessions may combine two trading days into one (e.g., if Monday is a holiday, Monday and Tuesday may count as a single trading day). This is especially important for consistency tracking: a combined day's profits count as one session.

FFN posts holiday schedules via Discord and the website. Traders are also responsible for checking the CME Group calendar at cmegroup.com.

Q: What does 'FLAT' mean?

A: FLAT means no open positions AND no pending orders of any kind on your chart. A limit order sitting in the market counts as NOT flat.

Q: Does news trading in evaluation affect my consistency percentage?

A: Yes. A large profitable news trade in evaluation will count toward your consistency calculation for that session. If it pushes one session above 40% (or 50% for Express MAX), your profit target increases to maintain consistency.
